svg.text: PROOF GUIDES (not printed on the roll)

text.font-family: Arial Narrow, Liberation Sans Narrow, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: red = 23 mm die-cut edge · grey dash = printable area 17.1 × 20.0 mm (Editor's own margins) · blue dash = fold line

text.font-family: Arial Narrow, Liberation Sans Narrow, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: PRINTED ON THE ROLL: the two text faces and the two 1.2 mm fold ticks at the label edges.

text.font-family: Arial Narrow, Liberation Sans Narrow, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: FOLD: adhesive-to-adhesive over a cable-tie tail on the fold line. Both faces then read upright.

text.font-family: Arial Narrow, Liberation Sans Narrow, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Every set uses the tie tag for consistency. Folding straight onto the cable is only viable to ~8 mm OD (face 5.2 mm) and is single-line at that size.

text.font-family: Arial Narrow, Liberation Sans Narrow, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: DEVICE SWATCH — the two chips under each label are end A | end B, each named on its own colour.

text.font-family: Arial Narrow, Liberation Sans Narrow, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: DK-1221 prints BLACK ONLY: the labels themselves carry no colour. On the rack, match the cable tie to the chip colour.
